title.narrative: Poverty Alleviation and Inclusive Development Across Rural Sindh (PAIDAR)

description.narrative: Poverty alleviation and inclusive development across rural Sindh (PAIDAR) is a five-year programme funded by the EU to support the Government of Sindh (GoS) in implementation of its Poverty Reduction Strategy (PRS). The long-term objective of PAIDAR is to contribute to sustainable poverty reduction and improvement of livelihoods of poor women, men and young people across Sindh province. title.narrative: Change in Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) for target HHs in supported villages

description.narrative: The MPI is an internationally renowned measure of nonmonetary poverty. The PAIDAR programme uses the national definition of the MPI that was developed with support by Oxford University and UNDP. The MPI is defined in the range between zero and one, whereby lower values correspond to a lower prevalence and intensity of multidimensional poverty. Thus, poverty reduction can be measured as a decrease in the total MPI for the target population. While the MPI is measured at householdlevel, several subindicators reflect the gender inequality within the household.PAIDAR is contributing to several but not all subindicators of the MPI. The targetsetting is recognizing this.

comment.narrative: Around 15000 households benefitting through business dev grant windows social services identified under Climate Resilient Settlement Plans.
